notes.title: EA 0.5.0 Version Released -- almost a new GamePlay
notes.notes:
Sorry, the new version was originally expected to be released in late July.
However, I temporarily decided to modify the game to change the map to a hex random space (dungeon?), after nearly 2 months of overtime efforts. I almost rebuild this game. And  the new version was finally released.
The new version includes

 The new rogue-like map form (hexagonal space dungeon)
 The new character Space Tongue Monster.
 Cards can summon mercenaries (mercenary system)


I am very happy to post this change.
The current game is still fun even after I have played at least 2,000 times in develop.This is the magic power of rogue like.
Thank you for your support and I highly recommend everyone to experience it again.
